claim_ceiling: This V1 artifact prepares a comparison contract for independent review only. It computes no production or oracle energy, executes none of the 96 cells or eleven controls, adjudicates no cubature, changes no kernel, computes no torque, DFT, real-150 vector, Jacobian, SVD, or identifiability result, reruns no Stage A execution, and authorizes no Stage B activity.

preserved_predicates.FIXED_ORDER_CUBATURE_INADEQUATE: at least one required component-case fails at order48 and, over orders 24,32,40,48, errors either increase by >=5% once or have two q_n>=0.95
preserved_predicates.NEAR_CONTACT_OR_TRANSITION_REGIME_UNDERS: REGIME_DEPENDENT_PRODUCTION_FAILURE holds, every failing small-gap or transition case has q_40>=0.95 or q_48>=0.95, and at least one wide long-range case passes orders 32,40,48
preserved_predicates.PRODUCTION_COMPARISON_TIMEOUT: the total, per-stage, per-case, or per-order work cap is exceeded or any required atomic comparison cell is missing
preserved_predicates.PRODUCTION_CUBATURE_VALIDATED_ON_TESTED_: both components pass accuracy_rule for every case at orders 32,40,48 and abs(P48-P40)<=1e-36+1e-6*abs(oracle)
preserved_predicates.PRODUCTION_FAILURE_NOT_LOCALIZED: one or more component-cases fail accuracy but no other registered root-cause predicate is fully satisfied
preserved_predicates.REGIME_DEPENDENT_PRODUCTION_FAILURE: the same component passes orders 32,40,48 in at least one frozen regime and fails all three orders in at least one other frozen regime
